sector-7.title: The Vanishing at Sector 7
sector-7.synopsis: Dr. Aris Thorne is found dead inside the airtight, locked cleanroom Sector 7 at Aether Biometrix. The cleanroom doors remained locked all night, but security cameras glitched for 90 seconds at 03:14 AM. The player must collect clues, expose false alibis, and discover how the killer moved the body inside the locked room without opening the doors.

clues.name: Body Position Report
clues.summary: Blood pooling (lividity) settled flat across Dr. Thorne's back and spine.
clues.inference: Proves Thorne died lying flat on the corridor floor for at least 30 minutes, not sitting upright in his lab chair.
clues.contradiction: Demolishes the staging in the chair; proves the victim was murdered elsewhere and moved post-mortem.

clues.name: Conveyor Belt Fabric Scrap
clues.summary: White synthetic fibers and rubber scuff marks caught in the narrow materials pass-through rollers.
clues.inference: Proves a heavy object clothed in a lab coat was forced through the wafer hatch while the main doors stayed sealed.
clues.contradiction: Explains how the body entered an airtight room without breaching the sealed 500-lb electromagnetic airlock door.

clues.name: Blue Chemical Residue
clues.summary: Fresh droplets of Fluorinert FC-40 coolant found on Dr. Elena Cruz's coat sleeve.
clues.inference: This liquid evaporates in 4 hours and exists only inside Sector 7. Proves Elena returned after hours despite her turnstile alibi.
clues.contradiction: Demolishes Elena's alibi that she left at 2:30 AM and went straight home.

clues.name: Smartwatch Telemetry Log
clues.summary: Bluetooth pairing log timestamped 03:14:10 AM at the Sector 7 console.
clues.inference: Matches Kevin Lin's wearable device, directly tying him to the console at the exact second the CCTV was disabled.
clues.contradiction: Demolishes Kevin's claim that he was asleep in the bunk room with his phone turned off.

clues.name: The Whistleblower Email
clues.summary: Unsent draft from Thorne to Marcus Vance timestamped 01:15 AM threatening federal regulatory disclosure.
clues.inference: Thorne threatened to report Vance's falsified sensor yield data to regulators by 08:00 AM, establishing Vance's murder motive.
clues.contradiction: Proves Marcus Vance had a multi-million-dollar emergency motive to silence Thorne before 8:00 AM.

clues.name: Thermal Sterilization Log
clues.summary: Sector 7 emergency heating cycle activated at 03:16 AM, ramping room to 65°C.
clues.inference: Explains how the killer sanitized the crime scene, baking away touch DNA, fingerprints, and fibers.
clues.contradiction: Proves the cleanroom was thermally scrubbed right after the camera blackout to eliminate forensic traces.

phantom-heir.title: Case 08-NX: The Phantom Heir
phantom-heir.synopsis: Julian Sterling, billionaire founder of Sterling Neural Dynamics, is found dead inside the soundproof, Faraday-shielded Obsidian Study vault at Sterling Ridge Manor. The biometric vault sealed at 10:42 PM, but liver temperature placed death at 02:00 AM, matching all suspects' alibis. Piercing through manipulated room physics, neural telemetry loops, and acoustic deepfakes, the detective must break the impossible locked room and identify the Phantom Heir before the estate trust transfers at noon.
phantom-heir.location: The Obsidian Study & Biometric Sanctuary, Sterling Ridge Manor

clues.name: Vitreous Potassium Assay
clues.summary: Syringe assay of fluid from Julian's ocular vitreous humor analyzed via ion spectrometer shows [K+] = 14.8 mmol/L.
clues.inference: Vitreous potassium degrades at a steady rate independent of ambient room temperature, proving Julian died between 10:30 PM and 10:50 PM.
clues.contradiction: Demolishes the coroner's 02:00 AM estimate and invalidates the suspects' midnight-to-dawn alibis.

clues.name: HVAC Thermal Inversion Log
clues.summary: Firmware logs from the Obsidian Study's automated climate control unit reveal an unauthorized temperature override.
clues.inference: At 10:45 PM, the room plunged to 6°C to accelerate body heat loss (algor mortis tampering), then reheated to 24°C at 04:30 AM.
clues.contradiction: Proves the ambient temperature was weaponized to delay the perceived time of death by over three hours.

clues.name: Transdermal DMSO Gel Residue
clues.summary: Microscopic clear film swabbed from the outer recessed rim of the vault thumbprint scanner glass.
clues.inference: Mass spectrometry detects Dimethyl Sulfoxide (DMSO) and synthetic Batrachotoxin, absorbed rapidly through intact skin upon touch.
clues.contradiction: Proves Julian was fatally poisoned the exact second he pressed his thumb to the scanner to lock the vault door at 10:40 PM.

clues.name: Cloned Neural Telemetry Glitch
clues.summary: Live brainwave EEG monitoring feed transmitted from Julian's neural implant to the estate medical server.
clues.inference: Between 11:00 PM and 02:00 AM, the Fourier transform pattern matches an identical recorded loop from three days prior.
clues.contradiction: Exposes that the 'live vitals' until 02:00 AM were a pre-recorded playback loop running on a scheduled cron-job.

clues.name: Holographic Disinheritance Codicil
clues.summary: Digitally signed codicil inside Julian's desktop safe, timestamped 09:00 PM on the night of the murder.
clues.inference: Confirms Dr. Cedric Laurent is Julian's secret illegitimate son ('The Phantom Heir') and was completely disinherited for black-market patent sales.
clues.contradiction: Establishes Cedric's devastating motive for murder just hours before the trust irrevocably sealed.

clues.name: Synthesized Intercom Acoustic Artifact
clues.summary: Spectral waveform analysis of the 01:30 AM security intercom call ('Do not disturb me until morning...').
clues.inference: Band-pass filtering reveals a 19.2 kHz digital aliasing artifact and VocalSynth-Pro watermark registered to Cedric's clinic laptop.
clues.contradiction: Proves Julian's late-night voice was a deepfake synthesis designed to fabricate proof of life after midnight.

scene_1_intro.speaker: OFFICER MILLER
scene_1_intro.text: Glad you arrived, Detective! Security called us at 6:00 AM. Dr. Aris Thorne was found dead in his chair inside Sector 7. The night guard assumed a sudden heart attack—until we checked the door logs.

scene_1_briefing_2.speaker: OFFICER MILLER
scene_1_briefing_2.text: Sector 7 is an airtight cleanroom sealed behind a 500-pound magnetic door. The electronic logs prove it was locked all night. Nobody entered, and nobody left. Yet at 3:14 AM, all security cameras went black for 90 seconds. A dead man inside an unbreakable room... this is murder, Detective.

choices_json.text: An impossible locked-room murder. Let us inspect the crime scene.

scene_1_body.speaker: DETECTIVE
scene_1_body.text: Look at his back under the UV light—the blood pooling (lividity) has settled completely flat along his spine! That means he died lying flat on the floor for at least 30 minutes. He was NOT killed in this chair; someone murdered him in the hallway and staged his body here!

choices_json.text: Discuss this breakthrough with Officer Miller

scene_1_conveyor.speaker: DETECTIVE
scene_1_conveyor.text: Look closely at this motorized conveyor hatch. It connects the outer hallway to the cleanroom. The killer could not open the heavy airlock door, so they shoved Thorne's dead body through this conveyor opening!

choices_json.text: Then how did the security cameras shut off for exactly 90 seconds at 3:14 AM?

scene_2_hub.speaker: DETECTIVE

scene_2_server.speaker: DETECTIVE
scene_2_server.text: Got him! At 3:14:10 AM, a blackout script called "bypass_loop.sh" killed the cameras. And right as it ran, a Bluetooth smartwatch connected to the console—matching Kevin Lin's watch (E4)! Even worse: at 3:16 AM, someone activated Sector 7's emergency heat cycle, blasting the room at 65°C to bake away all fingerprints and DNA (E6)!

scene_2_lab.speaker: DR. ELENA CRUZ
scene_2_lab.text: Excuse me, Detective? I have delicate experiments running—(you shine the UV light on her cuff)—Wait! Bright neon-blue liquid glows on her sleeve!
